audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Orianna x5 then Azir, Azir. Six of seven rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Content and packet agree, and the kit supports it: Command: Attack is 815 range on 7s at rank 1 falling to 3s maxed for a flat 35 mana, against Azir's 740-range Q on 14s at 70 mana. She out-ranges and out-sustains the poke war until Nashor's. 47.87% over 493 games matches a lane you lose then out-scale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side -> Orianna, phases[6].side -> Azir, with each .why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Her spike is level 6 Command: Shockwave (110/95/80s, 410 radius). Azir's are Nashor's Tooth and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s). Her E, Command: Protect, is 9s flat and is how the ball comes home — it is the cooldown that actually gates her, not her Q.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes plus phases[4]/[6].why rewritten around Shockwave and the ball's position.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every Shockwave line said to track HER. Command: Shockwave launches nearby enemies toward the BALL after a short delay — the ball's location is the danger zone, and it can be parked far from Orianna.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.' Command: Attack leaves the ball at the target location, and Command: Protect (1095 range, 9s) is the retrieval. So the whole matchup reads off ball position: ball parked away and Protect on cooldown is the only real green light, and Emperor's Divide's knock-back is the counter to the group Shockwave needs.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and phases[4].why all rewritten to track the ball rather than the champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT on breakdown.cooldowns, and the packet's own defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere — needs concrete wait-for-X-before-you-Y lines' (sequencingCues: 0).
audit.why: Command: Attack 7/6/5/4/3, Command: Dissonance 7 flat, Command: Protect 9 flat, Shockwave 110/95/80, Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16. The sequencing that matters: her Q reaches 3 seconds when maxed, so waiting it out is not a plan — the wait is Command: Protect at 9 seconds with the ball parked away from her.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the numbers AND an explicit wait-for-Protect-before-you-step-up line.

notes: CHART: phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side were the stale token 'Skill'; content win[] and packet.levelChart already agreed on Orianna x5 then Azir, Azir, so the full layer was moved onto them and every changed .why was rewritten in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edit exists to propose — win[N] is already correct on disk for all six rows. Ratings left untouched (scale orientation ambiguous). The packet's own defect ('NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues 0) is addressed by the breakdown.cooldowns rewrite: the concrete line is wait for Command: Protect (9s) with the ball parked away, because Command: Attack reaches 3s maxed and cannot be waited out. Deliberately unasserted: whether Shifting Sands can be used to escape Shockwave's delay, whether Sand Soldiers absorb Command: Attack, and whether Emperor's Divide's wall blocks the ball's travel — none of that is in Riot's text, so the copy only claims the knock-back breaking her grouping.
